items.title: Moderna pops on positive melanoma vaccine trial
items.summary: Moderna (MRNA) shares jumped after the company reported positive results from a late-stage trial of its personalized melanoma vaccine.  Bernstein senior analyst of US Biopharmaceuticals Courtney Breen joins Julie Hyman on Market Catalysts to break down the trial results, what’s driving the stock move, and the potential pricing opportunity for Moderna’s cancer vaccine.

items.title: Moderna, Merck melanoma cancer vaccine is a 'grand slam': Dr. Ezekiel Emanuel
items.summary: Dr. Ezekiel Emanuel sits down with Julie Hyman to discuss the late-stage trial results of the new mRNA cancer treatment vaccine being tested by Moderna (MRNA) and Merck (MRK). Dr. Emanuel was an advisor to President Obama and a member of the Biden-Harris Transition COVID-19 Advisory Board.

items.title: Moderna Plunges 20% One Day After Cancer Vaccine Breakthrough Sent Shares Up 177%
items.summary: Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) shares have crashed 20% as of 12:00 PM ET on Thursday after delivering one of the biotech sector’s most extraordinary single-day moves of 2026. CNBC co-anchor Andrew Ross Sorkin told viewers that Moderna’s Phase 3 results for its experimental cancer vaccine sent the stock soaring 177% on Wednesday, while partner Merck (NYSE:MRK) rallied ... items.title: After Day of Exuberance for Moderna’s Stock, Investors Pull Back
items.summary: The day after Moderna’s stock posted its biggest one-day gain on record, it is on track for its largest percent drop in more than two years as investors digested the news and adjusted their positions.  Prior to Wednesday’s rally on positive mRNA cancer vaccine data, Moderna’s stock had substantial short interest at 13.7%.  UBS said its clients sold a record $44 million in Moderna shares Wednesday, suggesting some investors were cashing out after the rally.

items.title: Yield Hunters Are Swarming This 6.3%-Dividend Stock—And Big-League Hedge Funds are Quietly Buying the Dip
items.summary: Hedge funds are quietly loading up on a battered pharma giant while yield hunters circle its once-near-7% dividend, but with a 14% rally already in the books and patent cliffs looming, the real question is whether the smart money spotted a turning point or a trap.

items.title: Why Merck Stock Got Downgraded After a Massive Cancer-Vaccine Win
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets analyst Trung Huynh downgrades shares of the Keytruda maker following a nearly 13% rally.

items.title: Moderna Sinks 18% After 177% Cancer Vaccine Rally, BioNTech Falls 4%, Merck Slips
items.summary: A historic one-session rally in a cancer vaccine stock is already unwinding, and Wall Street analysts disagree sharply on whether the reversal reflects a trade gone cold or an opportunity that the market is mispricing.
